faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting the CSIR NIScPR Consultant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the CSIR National Institute of Science Communication & Policy Research (CSIR NIScPR) based in New Delhi to hire qualified retired professionals for engineering consultancy roles.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post announced under this CSIR NIScPR notification?
faq.answer: The designated post advertised in this notification is Consultant (Electrical Engineering) under advertisement number NIScPR/09/I/2026-R&A for a total of one vacancy.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Consultant (Electrical Engineering) post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Consultant (Electrical Engineering) position, specifically structured for retired personnel possessing relevant technical background and expertise.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational and professional qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Applicants must be retired employees from CSIR, Central Government, or CAB who served as Electrical Engineers, with a distinct preference for individuals having expertise in Electrical and Refrigeration & Air Conditioning systems.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit to apply for CSIR NIScPR Consultant Recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants interested in the Consultant (Electrical Engineering) position is capped at 65 years as specified in the official guidelines of the recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the last date to submit the offline application form?
faq.answer: The last date for the receipt of filled-in application forms along with all relevant documents at the designated CSIR NIScPR office is 14-10-2026 by 5 PM.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for CSIR NIScPR Consultant (Electrical Engineering)?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly offline. Candidates are required to fill out the application form attached as Annexure 1 and submit it to the office of the Section Officer, Recruitment Cell.

faq.question: Q8. Where should the completed application form be submitted?
faq.answer: The completed application form along with necessary documents should be submitted to the office of the Section Officer, Recruitment Cell (Room No. 215) at CSIR NIScPR before the deadline.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for CSIR NIScPR Consultant positions?
faq.answer: The selection of candidates will be finalized through evaluation by a Screening-cum-selection committee conducting interviews for the shortlisted applicants who fulfill the eligibility criteria.

faq.question: Q10. Where can candidates find the official notification and application form details?
faq.answer: Candidates can access the official notification and download the application format directly through the official website of CSIR NIScPR or via the important links provided in this recruitment article.
